details: Demand and supply panels use the same 34-region annual key grid.
Four baselines; rolling 2019-2024 and recursive origins 2018-2021.
Missing observed DI Yogyakarta generation in 2020 is excluded from validation.
Demand Drift and supply Drift V1 forecasts for 2025-2030.
Accounting difference is local generation minus distributed electricity; it is not an adequacy indicator.
